description: This source file implements authentication business logic including user registration, login, JWT token creation and validation, with focus on security best practices such as input normalization, byte-length enforcement for bcrypt passwords, and error handling.

classes.name: AuthServiceError
classes.description: Base class for authentication service related exceptions.

classes.name: InvalidCredentialsError
classes.description: Exception raised when user login credentials are invalid.

classes.name: TokenValidationError
classes.description: Exception raised when JWT token validation fails.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Main class providing functionalities for user registration, authentication, JWT encoding/decoding, and user retrieval.

methods.name: str _normalized_password(password: str)
methods.description: Normalizes password input by stripping whitespace and validating type/emptiness.

methods.name: bool _password_within_bcrypt_bounds(password: str)
methods.description: Checks if password's UTF-8 byte length is between 8 and 72 bytes, inclusive.

methods.name: User register_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Registers a new user with normalized password after enforcement of bcrypt length policy.

methods.name: Tuple[User,str] authenticate_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns user object along with JWT token if successful.

methods.name: str _create_access_token(self, *, subject: str)
methods.description: Generates a JWT token embedding user ID as subject, with expiration based on settings.

methods.name: TokenPayload decode_token(self, token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token, raising errors if invalid or expired.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user_by_id(self, db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a user record by user ID directly from database session.

ctags.name: authenticate_user
ctags.pattern: /^    def authenticate_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)

ctags.name: get_user_by_id
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_user_by_id(self, db: Session, user_id: int) -> Optional[User]:$/

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^    def register_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str) -> User:$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
